events_summary.content: Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.

events_summary.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events_summary.content: Guards! Arrest this imposter!
Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.

events_summary.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
events_summary.content: We will not.
Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.

events_summary.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events_summary.content: I said arrest him!

events_summary.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events_summary.content: Why?!
Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.

events_summary.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
events_summary.content: Because we know who he is.
Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.

events_summary.speaker: CATHERINE
events_summary.content: Rupert...
Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.

events_summary.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events_summary.content: You cannot be him. Alexander died!
Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.
Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events_summary.content: Alexander...
Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: Mother.
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events_summary.content: Look at you... my beautiful boy.
Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events_summary.content: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: I have come home, Mother.
Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events_summary.content: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!
Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.
Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content:
And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole."
